description: Create a new rule ruleset with source text and test cases (TDD). Test cases are required. After creation, call aethis_generate_and_test.

contract_version.description: Required when acceptance expectations, expected_review_bindings or retained_passages are supplied.

expected_review_bindings.description: Optional review-binding catalogue; omit for no assertion or use {} to assert zero bindings.

name.description: Human-readable name for the rule ruleset

retained_passages.description: Optional list of source passages that must be retained in the rule notes. Each is {id, text} with text at most 2000 characters; matching ignores case, whitespace runs and typographic quotes and checks literal retention, not meaning.

text.description: Source text that must be retained

source_text.description: The source legislation, policy, or specification text

test_cases.description: Test cases with optional strict acceptance expectations.

field_errors.description: Exact message the engine is expected to report for each field when an input invariant rejects the inputs. Only valid when expected_outcome is undetermined.

name: aethis_create_ruleset
